data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. The system is optimized for filtered views when handling large datasets. To improve performance, please use the search bar or apply specific filters, such as 'Status: Active', immediately upon loading the page. If you are looking for a specific person, navigating directly to their profile via the search function will be much faster than loading the full list. [T-379] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
